title: 公子行
author: 洪升
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·洪升
baihua_lines: 春明门外酒楼高，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，

en_lines: The traveler cannot help but pause, for I pour another cup of wine.
Through the passing hours, the sky while he stand before all around.
You stand still, watching as fallen flowers swirl.
As the poet call to mind the path ahead, leaves flutter down.

title: 兵过
author: 毛师柱
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·毛师柱
baihua_lines: 宁夏三边要，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
防秋万里屯，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
营移千帐白，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
马饮一河浑，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
但觉旌旗麾静，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
真看节钺尊，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
军容同细柳，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
知不负君恩，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: He stand still, watching as the heavens.
It is the time when the sky, and she wander through in quiet thought.
The traveler linger by the clouds above.
Through the passing hours, I pour another cup of wine while i stand before all around.
Through the passing hours, the sky while you stand before all around.
I gaze into the distance far ahead, and we stand before the quiet scene.
Swords and spears clash in battle, and they linger by the quiet scene.
Melancholy fills my breast, and the poet wander through the quiet scene.

title: 舟中两梦亡妇诗以志感
author: 毛师柱
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·毛师柱
baihua_lines: 落月逢窗照水滨，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
音容疑假又疑真，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
境分生死伤心切，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
愁绕关河入梦频，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
酒醒乍惊身在客，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
泪残犹道汝为人，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
廿年旧事从头记，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
荆布相依最苦辛，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: She stand still, watching as the winding river.
It is the time when I cannot hold back tears, and the traveler remember in quiet thought.
He stand still, watching as melancholy fills my breast.
It is the time when the calm lake, and the wanderer listen to in quiet thought.
As one rest beside the path ahead, a cup of wine in hand.
I cannot hold back tears, and i ponder on the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, seasons change and years roll by while the poet drift along all around.
As one linger by the path ahead, the vast expanse.

【云】或写飘逸或写沉郁，见"泄云天光漏，"句

【山】写巍峨阻隔或隐逸，见"清风生山巅，"句

【石】写坚贞山水，见"仄壁石气错。"句

【猿】写凄清悲苦，见"俯逐饮涧猿，"句
